svg.title: A story's path
svg.desc: A moment becomes a story only after a verifier has checked every number and name against the evidence; Ask a live match reads only what the viewer has seen.
svg.text: How a story is made, and how a wrong one is stopped
Code finds the moment and packs the evidence. A model phrases it for one viewer. A verifier decides whether it is shown.
club must be in the pack
that is not in the pack
hit: instant verified text, the model is skipped
Counted on the Operations page: how many stories were model-written, repaired or templated, and how many claims were verified. A story is never silently wrong.
ASK THE MATCH WHILE IT IS PLAYED the answer can only use what you have already seen
an interpreter rebuilt from only the documents
that had arrived by your position, never past the clock
never loaded: a goal or red card you have not seen
match clock on the server (the live edge)
Checked on Azure: a red card at minute 45, the match clock at minute 4, the position forced to minute 133. The answer came from minute 4 and did not mention it.
